sources.title: darjusul/wav2vec2-ONNX-collection · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Overview This project provides pre-converted Wav2Vec2 models from PyTorch/Hugging Face format to ONNX format, making them suitable for deployment in various production environments. The conversion maintains model accuracy while providing significant inference speed improvements.

sources.title: facebook/wav2vec2-xls-r-1b · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Facebook's Wav2Vec2 XLS-R counting 1 billion parameters. XLS-R is Facebook AI's large-scale multilingual pretrained model for speech (the "XLM-R for Speech"). It is pretrained on 436k hours of unlabeled speech, including VoxPopuli, MLS, CommonVoice, BABEL, and VoxLingua107. It uses the wav2vec 2.0 objective, in 128 languages.

sources.title: torchaudio.models.wav2vec2_xlsr_1b — Torchaudio 2.3.0 documentation
sources.snippet: Builds XLS-R model [Babu et al., 2021] with 1 billion of parameters. The architecture is compatible with Wav2Vec2 model [Baevski et al., 2020], and so the output class is Wav2Vec2Model.
